messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy is unlikely to disappear completely, because legal protections, encryption, and social resistance will keep personal privacy alive. Privacy
Consciousness copying by 2030 is extremely unlikely, because we lack full brain mapping, neural theory, and ethical tools. Consciousness
Wireless coverage everywhere is plausible for many regions by the 2030s, though polar, ocean, remote, and infrastructure limits may remain. Wireless
Electric transport is highly likely for cars, buses, and short-range vehicles, yet aviation, shipping, and heavy freight may remain hybrid or use other fuels. Electric
Climate impacts are already becoming irreversible in glaciers, ecosystems, and sea-level rise, even if emissions stop soon. Climate
Physical cash is unlikely to vanish globally, because emergencies, privacy, and uneven adoption will keep coins and notes in use for years. Physical
Genetic life extension is possible in some forms, but centuries or immortality remains highly speculative and faces biology, ethics, and inequality barriers. Genetic
